senses.gloss: 1. वि—हर्ष m. excessive joy or gladness, MW.
2. वि—हर्ष mfn. joyless, sad, BhP.
वि-हर्ष , वि-हस्त &c. See p. 953, col. 2.

unhandy, inexperienced (see अ-विह्˚)

(ifc.) completely absorbed in Ragh.

वि—हस्त m. a eunuch, L.

वि—हस्तित mfn. confused, embarrassed, Kathās.

2. वि-हायस् m. n. (for 1. See p. 953, col. 2) the open space (cf. वि-यत्), air, sky, atmosphere, Mn.; MBh. &c. (also ˚सः-स्थली f. or ˚सस्-तल n.; instr. ˚सा, ‘through the sky’)
वि-हायस् m. a bird, Kautukas.
वि—हिंस्र See s.v.
वि-˚हिंस्र See अ-विहिंस्र.
1. वि—हित mfn. (for 2. see under वि-√ धा) improper, unfit, not good, W.
वि-हित See s.v.
2. वि॑-हित mfn. (fr., वि- √ 1. धा, p. 967; for 1. वि-हित See p. 953, col. 2) distributed, divided, apportioned, bestowed, supplied &c.
put in order, arranged, determined, fixed, ordained, ordered, RV. &c. &c.
prescribed, decreed, enjoined, GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

विह—ग m. ‘sky-goer’, a bird, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

वि॑-हत mfn. torn up, furrowed, TBr.; ŚBr.

disturbed, impeded, Kāv.; Pur.

arrangement or disposition (of the 3 sacred fires; also applied to the fires themselves or the space between them), ŚrS.

walking for pleasure or amusement, wandering, roaming, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
sport, play, pastime, diversion, enjoyment, pleasure (‘in’ or ‘with’ comp.; ifc. also = taking delight in), Yājñ.; MBh.; R. &c.
a place of recreation, pleasure-ground, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

(with Buddhists or Jainas) a monastery or temple (originally a hall where the monks met or walked about; afterwards these halls were used as temples), Lalit.; Mṛcch.; Kathās. &c. (cf. MWB. 68; 81 &c.)
consecration for a sacrifice, Āpast.
N. of the country of Magadha (called Bihār or Behār from the number of Buddhist monasteries See MWB. 68), Cat.

वी-हार m. = वि-ह्˚, a temple, sanctuary, (esp.) a Jaina or Buddhist convent or temple, W.
वि-√ हर्य् P. -हर्यति, to scorn, repudiate, Nir. vii, 17 (cf. अ-विहर्यत-क्रतु).
विह॑ल्ह m. (of unknown meaning), AV. vi, 16, 1.
वि-हव &c. See वि-√ ह्वे, p. 1004.
वि-हव॑ m. invocation, RV.; AitBr.

to laugh at (acc., rarely gen.), Kāv.; BhP.; Pañcat.
वि-हसतिका f. gentle laughter, smiling, Hcar. (v.l. ˚सितिका).
वि-˚हसन n. id., W.
वि-˚हसित mfn. laughing, smiling, Hariv.; Caurap.

वि-˚हसितिका See ˚हसतिका.
वि-हास m. laughing, laughter, Hariv.; Pañcar.
वि-हास mfn. opened, L.
वि-√ 1. हा Ā. -जिहीते, to go apart, become expanded, start asunder, open, fly open, gape, yawn, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr. : Caus.: -हापयति, to cause to gape, open, AV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.
विहा ind. = स्वर्ग, heaven, Uṇ. iv, 36, Sch.
विह (only ibc.) the sky, air.
विह—ग—पति m. ‘king of birds’, N. of Garuḍa, Kāv.
विह—ग—वेग m. ‘having the swiftness of a bird’, N. of a Vidyā-dhara, Bālar.
विह—गाधिप m. (= -पति), L.

a cloud, L.
the sun, L.
the moon, L.

विह—ं-ग—हन् m. a bird-killer, bird-catcher, MBh.
विह—ं-˚गाराति m. ‘bird-enemy’, a falcon or hawk.
विह—ं-गक m. a little bird, any bird, Hcar.
विह—ं-गिका f. a sort of pole or yoke for carrying burdens, L.
N. of a woman, Veṇīs.
विह—ं-गम mfn. moving in the sky, flying, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
विह—ं-गम m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a bird, Mn.; MBh. &c.
विह—ं-गम m. the sun, MBh.

विह—ं-गमा f. a female bird, MBh.
next, L.
विह—ं-गमिका f. a sort of yoke (= विहं-गिका), L.

वि-हायसस्-तल n., the open space (cf. वि-यत्), air, sky, atmosphere, Mn.; MBh. &c.
वि-हाय˚सा-गामिन् mfn. able to move through the sky, L.
वि-हाय॑स m. n. heaven, sky, atmosphere, TĀr.; MBh.; Hariv.

वि-हित—त्व n. the being enjoined or prescribed, prescription, direction, Hcat.

to stagger, totter, stumble, Kāṭh.

वि-√ हुर्छ् (or -हूर्छ्) P. -हूर्छति, to waddle, toddle, sway from one side to another (applied to a corpulent person's gait), ŚBr.;
to stagger, totter, stumble, Kāṭh.
वि-˚हरण n. the act of taking away or removing or changing or transposing, Lāṭy.; MārkP.
opening, expanding, Pāṇ. i, 3, 20
stepping out, ib. i, 3, 41
going about for pleasure or exercise, roaming, strolling, Kāv.; Pur.; Suśr.
taking out for a walk or for airing, Gobh.
moving to and fro, brandishing, MBh.

वि-हार—वत् mfn. possessing a place of recreation, Mn.; MBh.

वि-हार—वन n. a pleasure-grove, Daś.
वि-हार—वापी f. ‘pl˚-pond’, N. of wk.
वि-हार—वारि n. water for sporting or playing about in Ragh.
वि-हार—शयन n. a pl˚-couch, R.

serving for the amusement of (comp.), Mālatīm.
roaming or walking about, a roamer, MW.
belonging to a Buddhist temple or convent, ib.

going as far as, extending to (comp.), R.; Rājat.
dependent on (comp.), MBh.
enjoying one's self with, delighting in, given or addicted to, fond of (comp.), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.

वि-˚हारिणी f. a girl too fond of gadding about (unfit for marriage), L.
वि-˚हा˚रि-सिंह m. N. of a king, Inscr.
वि-हृत mfn. set or put asunder, distributed, disposed &c.
transposed, varied (as words or Pādas), ŚrS.
वि-हृत n. a walk, R.
hesitation, reluctance, bashful silence (one of the 10 Hāvas or feminine modes of indicating love), Daśar.; Sāh.

वि-˚हृति f. expansion, increase, growth, Kir.

वि-√ हेठ् Caus. P. -हेठयति, to hurt, injure, Lalit.

वि-ह्वल m. myrrh, L.
वि-ह्वलम् ind.
वि-ह्वल—चेतन (MBh.) mfn. distressed in mind, low-spirited
वि-ह्वल—चेतस् (Kathās.) mfn. distressed in mind, low-spirited
वि-ह्वल—तनु mfn. one whose body is exhausted by (comp.), Pañcat.
